parties: Dain Colour Chem Limited (Issuer), Horizon Management Pvt Ltd (Book Running Lead Manager), Maheshwari Datamatics Pvt Ltd (Registrar)
headline: Dain Colour Chem files DRHP for book-built SME IPO on BSE
sum: Dain Colour Chem Limited, an integrated manufacturer of synthetic and specialty food colours with over a decade of operational experience, has filed a DRHP with BSE SME for a fresh issue of 31 lakh shares with an offer size of ₹30 crore+. Legacy Law Offices is advising both the issuer and the BRLM, Horizon Management.
implication: SME IPO structure allows smaller, high-growth chemical manufacturers efficient access to capital without full mainboard compliance burden; counsel must track BSE SME-specific FEMA and disclosure requirements distinct from mainboard rules.
detail: <cite index="1-1">Dain Colour Chem Limited filed a DRHP with the BSE on 21 August 2026.</cite> <cite index="1-3,1-4">The IPO is a book-built issue consisting solely of a fresh issue of up to 0.31 crore equity shares, proposed to be listed on the BSE SME.</cite> <cite index="1-11,1-12">Incorporated in January 2023, the company is an integrated manufacturer of synthetic food colours and specialty colour solutions with a diversified portfolio including synthetic, lake, blended, natural, pharmaceutical and cosmetic colours.</cite> <cite index="2-6,2-7">The company's total income grew 38% to ₹55.04 crore in Mar 2026, with profit after tax rising 44% to ₹8.27 crore.</cite>
